cards.title: Appendix Archive Lab Story Series Card
cards.seriesSkill: keep a multi-page archive lab story series steady with a named tab, returning helper, setting notes, and one carried clue
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only tabbed-folder card for guiding a private fictional archive lab story series across more than one page: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place this card in the story folder, choose the appendix archive lab tab, and set out two blank pages for a gentle series plan: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: start page one, then use the tab to help the helper, lab setting, and clue return on the next page of the story series: ____________________.
cards.pageOneAnchorPrompt: Page one anchor: write the first page so the archive helper, the appendix shelf, and the lab job are clear before the next page begins: ____________________.
cards.characterReturnPrompt: Character return: choose one helper who comes back on each page, then write the small habit or tool that helps readers know it is the same character: ____________________.
cards.settingReturnPrompt: Setting return: add one lab detail that can return under the same story folder tab, such as a paper drawer, margin map, or lamp label: ____________________.
cards.clueCarryPrompt: Clue carry: carry one gentle clue from page one to the next page, and write where it waits inside the appendix archive lab: ____________________.
cards.pageTurnPrompt: Page turn: end the page with a quiet reason to turn to the next page, such as a missing label, new drawer, or note under the tab: ____________________.
cards.seriesWrapPrompt: Story series wrap: on the last page, bring back the helper, lab setting, and carried clue so the story folder feels complete: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult points to the tab, and the writer adds only one return detail for the next page: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: continue a paper-only archive lab story series in a story folder by carrying one helper, one setting detail, and one clue to the next page: ____________________.

cards.title: Clue Label Tower Museum Story Series Card
cards.seriesSkill: build story series continuity by using a tabbed folder to track labels, returning museum roles, and clues that move page by page
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only tabbed-folder card for a private fictional tower museum story series with clue labels across pages: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place a blank card behind the story folder tab and ask the writer to name one tower museum label that can guide several pages: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: use the tab to remember which museum helper returns, where the tower setting stays, and which clue moves to the next page: ____________________.
cards.pageOneAnchorPrompt: Page one anchor: write the first page so the tower museum, the clue label, and the first helper job are easy to follow: ____________________.
cards.characterReturnPrompt: Character return: write one detail that brings the same museum helper back on the next page without changing the story series path: ____________________.
cards.settingReturnPrompt: Setting return: choose one tower museum place that stays under the tab, such as a label stair, archive rail, or quiet map wall: ____________________.
cards.clueCarryPrompt: Clue carry: copy the clue label onto the story folder card, then carry it into the next page with one new thing it helps reveal: ____________________.
cards.pageTurnPrompt: Page turn: end the page with a soft question about the label so the next page has a clear reason to begin: ____________________.
cards.seriesWrapPrompt: Story series wrap: finish by connecting the first clue label, the returning helper, and the tower museum place on the final page: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult writes the clue label on the tab, and the writer adds only one sentence for the next page: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: keep a tower museum story series in a story folder by moving one clue label from page to next page on paper: ____________________.

cards.title: Compass Craft Academy Story Series Card

cards.kidDirection: Writer: write page one, then let the tab help you bring back the same academy helper, room, and compass clue on the next page: ____________________.

cards.characterReturnPrompt: Character return: decide how the same helper returns on each page, such as checking the compass card or sorting the craft strips: ____________________.
cards.settingReturnPrompt: Setting return: keep one academy place steady under the tab, such as a north shelf, folded map desk, or quiet practice hall: ____________________.
cards.clueCarryPrompt: Clue carry: carry one compass clue from page one to the next page and write how it changes the helper's plan: ____________________.
cards.pageTurnPrompt: Page turn: end the page when the compass points toward a new paper sign, giving the next page a calm starting point: ____________________.
cards.seriesWrapPrompt: Story series wrap: bring the compass clue, academy helper, and return setting together so the final page answers the first page: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult circles one tab note, and the writer adds only the next page direction sentence: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: build another paper-only compass story series by keeping one tab note for the helper, place, and clue on every page: ____________________.
